thesis: Order of the Ebon Hand gave black aggro the same mana-intensive combat flexibility as its white rival, backed by protection from white and Dark Ritual acceleration.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The Order anchored black aggressive decks from Fallen Empires forward and remains inseparable from the era’s mirrored Knight cycle and early color-hate combat.

playbook.role: Use pump and first strike only when they win combat or shorten the clock, and exploit protection from white against common removal and blockers. Double-black demands deliberate mana construction.
